info: UDEV rules for different client types. $...$ expressions are replaced automatically ($MAC$, $VID$, $PID$, $DEVNAME$)

network_devices.comment: USB tethering of a mobile handset
network_devices.udev_rule: SUBSYSTEM=="net", SUBSYSTEMS=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="$VID$", ATTRS{idProduct}=="$PID$", NAME="$DEVNAME$", ENV{raspapType}="$TYPE$"

network_devices.comment: recognized mobile data modems are automatically named as ppp0-9. Renaming is not possible. Dialin service relies on the name
Huawei mobile data device in router mode. Control via HTTP. Device is connecting via service
network_devices.udev_rule: SUBSYSTEM=="net", SUBSYSTEMS=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="$VID$", ATTRS{idProduct}=="$PID$", NAME="$DEVNAME$", ENV{raspapType}="$TYPE$", TAG+="systemd", ENV{SYSTEMD_WANTS}="start start_huawei_hilink@hilink%n.service"

network_devices.comment: ethernet access provided by tethering from phone via USB
network_devices.udev_rule: SUBSYSTEM=="net", SUBSYSTEMS=="usb", ATTRS{idVendor}=="$VID$", ATTRS{idProduct}=="$PID$", NAME="$DEVNAME$", ENV{raspapType}="$TYPE$"
